name: geqo
description: Enables or disables the genetic algorithm for query plan generation, used as an alternative to exhaustive search for complex queries.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for complex joins
Excessive planning time for large join queries
Poor scalability with increasing number of join relations
tuning_tips: Keep 'geqo = on' for production unless diagnosing planner issues; disable only for debugging or when 'geqo_threshold' is set high enough that GEQO rarely triggers. Prefer tuning 'geqo_threshold' first to control when GEQO activates.
